### The Advance of the Gospel
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-advance-of-the-gospel
Passage: Philippians 1:12-13
Points:
- God often uses the hardships and imprisonment of His servants to advance the message of Christ.
- Paul's confinement gave him a direct platform to share the gospel with the imperial guard.
- God works through lowly and unexpected situations so His glory is clearly displayed.
- Hardship becomes a source of joy because divine strength is revealed through human weakness.
